name: What should I ask before approving a new kitchen layout?

mainEntity.name: What should I ask before approving a new kitchen layout design?
mainEntity.text: What should I ask before approving a new kitchen layout design?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before approving a kitchen layout, it helps to test the plan against everyday life. Ask where groceries will land, how many people can cook at once, whether the dishwasher and oven doors can open freely, and whether the island or peninsula creates traffic problems. Also ask what changes are required behind the walls, including plumbing, electrical, gas, ventilation, and structure. A layout that looks great in a drawing may fail in real use if it does not support circulation, storage, and appliance clearance. It is also worth asking whether the design fits the home’s style and resale expectations. If the plan solves one problem but creates two new ones, it probably needs revision. The best layout is the one that makes cooking, cleanup, entertaining, and daily movement easier without adding unnecessary complexity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before approving a kitchen layout, ask how people will move through the space, where storage will go, whether appliances have enough clearance, and what structural or mechanical changes are required. A good layout should solve daily problems, not just look appealing on paper.
